task.problem_statement: Trained quantum-learning models need to be saved and restored without serializing their live execution environment. Reloading a model with a supplied executor should preserve its learned parameters, quantum circuit and observable representations, and predictions.
requirements: Save and restore quantum neural networks, kernel models, and reservoir-computing models through file paths or binary streams.
Preserve predictions after a serialization round trip for the supported quantum execution backends.
Exclude executor instances from the serialized payload and reinsert the supplied executor on loading, including repeated or nested references.
Reject unsupported input and output object types.

interface.Name: SerializableModelMixin
interface.Description: Supplies serialization to the supported model classes.

interface.Name: SerializableModelMixin.dump
interface.Description: Writes to a string file path or binary IOBase stream and removes executor references from the payload.

interface.Name: SerializableModelMixin.load
interface.Description: Class method restoring the model and all executor references from a string file path or binary stream.
